description: Backend fixes: add priority field to GlobalPopup model, sort popup query by priority, add ObjectId search to admin getPosts, verify soft delete logic (already correct), add diagnostic log to mobile api.ts
steps: In backend/src/modules/admin/globalPopup.model.js: Add 'priority: { type: Number, default: 0 }' field to the schema before the timestamps option.
In backend/src/modules/admin/config.routes.js: Change the global-popup route's .sort() from { updatedAt: -1 } to { priority: -1, createdAt: -1 } to return highest-priority active popup first.

In backend/src/modules/admin/admin.service.js getPosts(): After the existing query.$or block that searches caption and tags, add: if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/.test(search)) { query.$or.push({ _id: search }); }
In mobile/src/services/api.ts: Add console.log('[API] BASE_URL:', BASE_URL); immediately after the line 'const BASE_URL: string = getBaseUrl();'

Verify backend/src/modules/posts/post.service.js deletePost: Confirm it only does soft delete (sets deletedAt) for all callers. The admin hard-delete path is in admin.service.js deletePost. No Cloudinary calls in post.service.js deletePost - CONFIRMED already correct.

Verify backend/src/modules/users/user.validation.js: Confirm updateProfileSchema has username, fullName, avatarUrl, dob, role, subRoles, interests, bio, nsfwBlurEnabled, showMatureContent, location, website. All present - CONFIRMED correct.
acceptance_criteria: globalPopup.model.js has a 'priority' field of type Number with default 0
config.routes.js global-popup route sorts by { priority: -1, createdAt: -1 }
admin.service.js getPosts() includes ObjectId search when search is 24-char hex
post.service.js deletePost does NOT call cloudinary (only sets deletedAt) - verified no change needed
user.validation.js has all required fields including location and website - verified no change needed
findings: All 4 code changes verified with node --check (exit 0). TypeScript not available in sandbox but change is trivial (single console.log). Environment requires NODE_OPTIONS='' to clear preload module for node --check to work.
